correctness.rationale: For each local pair, the Gödel residual is either 1 (forward orientation) or the local minimum (reverse), while the diamond contribution is always that minimum. Independent conditional fair orientations force precisely one greater pattern and precisely one equality pattern per fixed set of distinct local minima; all others are less. For iid continuous inputs, integrating the two disjoint regions of the unit square gives q(u,v)=h(v)+[h(v)-h(u)]_+. The n-fold product determines all joint probabilities, gives two singular masses h(v)^n and the differentiated wedge density, with total mass one. At u=s/n and v=1-t/sqrt(n) the survival probability tends to exp(-s-t^2), proving independent exponential/Rayleigh limits. The boundary n=1 is checked; explicit counterexample outside exchangeability shows necessity of stating hypotheses. Actual checker.py completed orientations n=1..11 and 160000 independent simulations at five n with ALL_CHECKS_OK. Finite tests are not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: The 2026 witnessed fuzzy Gödel logic motivates how diamond and box can draw their degrees from the same successor. Even for atomless independent draws the joint distribution has two singular components (box at 1 and box equal to diamond) of identical exact mass 2^{-n}; the comparison category is independent of the complete unordered input geometry. The complete bivariate law and two distinct independent extreme limits identify a structural probabilistic phenomenon for nondual modalities, not an arbitrary small-parameter enumeration or a restatement of Gödel residuation. The precise fact can inform random fuzzy-model testing and quantitative modal witness analysis.
